description: Domanialité et gestionnaire de la voirie automobile et mixte sur Rennes Métropole is a dataset listed in Rennes-metropole open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Rennes Métropole - Direction de la Voirie - Services généraux Patrimoine. Cette couche indique pour les voiries du territoire de Rennes Métropole la domanialité du foncier et qui en assure la gestion. Coverage: Rennes Métropole. The portal files it under Mobilité, Transport. Its keywords are route. The portal shows 48,846 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2019-09-05 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence ODbL 1.0 (http://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-rennesmetropole-fr-portal.
